frames.barycentric: Query barycentric wavelength cb+x. Native topocentric-air wavelength first multiplied by(1+BERVepoch/c) once.

grid.core: abs(x)<=0.25: 51 sampled centers [-0.25,+0.25]. Exact original core [3865.4275000000002,3865.9275000000002] Angstrom; not a fitted physical linewidth.
grid.interpolation: Linear without extrapolation; mask brackets >1.51 times the median full-source barycentric wavelength step. Save selected source points plus one bracket on each side and the exact full-source spacing.

normalization.rule: Per profile and frame, pooled signed median of native samples with 1.5<=abs(frame offset)<=3, requiring at least 20 finite samples separately in each flank and a positive pooled median. No fitted background, continuum or line model.
normalization.missing: Zero native left/right coverage is MISSING_LEFT/RIGHT_FLANK_COVERAGE; insufficient finite counts are separate. Invalid or nonpositive references keep raw-only arrays and block normalized RMS. No moved flanks, sign flip, shrink or extrapolation.
normalization.context: Separate left/right native and finite counts, medians and nonpositive fractions; available median distinct from valid reference; signed-window nonpositive fraction and positive finite ERR coverage. Native BUNIT unspecified; merged ADU verified.
normalization.noise: First-difference 1.4826 MAD / sqrt(2) of finite adjacent source samples with both endpoints in the same fixed flank and spacing <=1.51 times median step. Never bridge flanks or gaps. Descriptive low-reference flag median<=3*proxy only if reference valid; no formal SNR.
normalization.structured_neighbor: Retain every fixed-flank source sample and spectral structure without masks or an assumed line-free region. C011 wider window overlaps C012 on the same seven HD112410 observing products, and original C011 epoch/raw evidence exists. Pooled medians are descriptive reference levels, not fitted or established line-free continua.

comparisons.merged: 7 target-specific epochs × 1 fixed May discovery reference × 2 frames × 2 regions = 28 records, including 4 identical-product self rows.
comparisons.native: 2 native covering-order contexts × 2 frames × 2 regions = 8 same-exposure native-to-merged records; shared extraction is dependent, not another observation or a physical flux ratio.
comparisons.statistics: Unshifted raw Pearson requires at least ceil(.8*Nregion) common finite raw samples and nonzero exact range. Normalized RMS requires that support in common finite normalized samples. Raw-only profiles block normalized RMS but retain adequately covered raw Pearson. Counts and reasons remain explicit.
comparisons.self_and_dependency_flags: Retain same_exposure and identical_product_self_pair flags, one fixed May 28 discovery, all seven reused HD112410 products and same-target C012 wider-window pixel overlap. Different reference identity does not add observations.

bounded_arrays: Save 9 pre-interpolation source windows with exact indices, original-frame and barycentric wavelengths, signed flux, ERR (NaN for unavailable native errors), source hashes, BERV and full-source spacing. Read only the union needed by both fixed-frame windows plus brackets; no extrapolation or original-pipeline replay.
headers: Check all seven HD112410 merged headers and the May discovery native header before new flux access: exact identities/hashes/metadata, numeric BERV, merged barycentric-air Angstrom/ADU and unique WAVE/FLUX/ERR single-exposure tables, native 72×4096 shape and fresh polynomial coefficients for each selected order. Geometric support, finite flux, reference validity and historical mapping reliability remain distinct.
preserved_raw_context: Copy exact historical V2E2-0089 raw/native NPZ panels and display original raw_cutout/raw_excess after release at separate full scales. Preserve primary U, secondary U and adopted U reviews, and true global/local/baseline/later five-window stages for both original covering orders. Do not transfer C012 order 2 local/baseline failures. No new registration, subtraction, spatial model, pixel statistic or origin claim.

release_contract.policy: Exact public method freeze and input hashes before new observed values; no network; one-shot output refuses overwrite; all source and release hashes rechecked after execution.

plot_rules: Four fixed figures: all seven merged epochs in broad/core signed and scaled views in both frames, every retained native order and both original raw/excess pairs. The 0089/R012 marker denotes catalog/discovery coordinates, not fitted peaks. Retain raw-only reasons, any low/invalid reference and partial support. Same-quantity merged scales match across frames; native raw scales match across frames per order. Every finite value remains with 5 percent margins; raw images use separate full extrema. No smoothing, clipping, favorable epoch selection or contrast variant.
limitations: Post-detection context of one U record and seven reused HD112410 exposures; V2E2-0089 remains U. No new observing time, independent detection or archive-wide completeness.
